_readme: fauxplane's colour, in the ROLE terms the hub's PALETTES.md defines. The gate lives in the hub and is never forked: run it from this repo with `npm run palette`, which is `node ../noahjefferson/palette-check.mjs palettes/fauxplane.json`. Two entries, because panel DIMMING is implemented as measured palette blocks rather than as a brightness filter — see the note below.
_why-two-blocks: A CSS brightness() filter over the whole panel is the obvious way to dim a cockpit display and it silently destroys every contrast pair this gate measured: the +0.05 term in the WCAG formula means scaling both foreground and background REDUCES the ratio. Measured on this palette, brightness(0.45) takes primary text from 14.5:1 to about 3.7:1 — a fail state, arrived at by a control whose whole purpose is legibility. So dimming switches between two blocks that have each been measured, and the dimmest one still clears every floor.
